appraisal_events.evidence: elle s'arrêtait souvent, forçant ses amies qui semblaient la respecter beaucoup, à interrompre aussi leur marche
appraisal_events.explanation: The girl presumed to be Mlle Simonet is shown commanding implicit authority within her group, whose members appear to defer to her by halting whenever she does.

status_effects.explanation: Within the little band she is locally elevated as a figure whose friends yield to her movements, suggesting a degree of informal precedence among her peers.

ambiguities: The identity of the girl described as 'présumée être Mlle Simonet' is explicitly hedged by the narrator, who later states he was never fully certain any girl in the group matched the one first glimpsed; the resolution to Albertine therefore carries some reference uncertainty.
